question: On bounce (3rd down close), does a more negative 7-day return (deeper short-term drawdown into the bounce) produce a better subsequent stop-based R than a milder ret7? Expect the most-negative ret7 bucket to have the best avg_stop_r.
plain: Tests whether stocks that fell harder over the prior week bounce better afterward (short-term reversal / Connors RSI-2 idea).
